name: Saimin Inkou ~Mou Hitori no Midara na Watashi~
original_name: 催眠淫行 ～もう一人の淫らな私～
source:
*Hidden inside me is a complete whore*

Kanami Wakaeda was proposed to by a schoolboy she didn't know.
Her rejection enraged him, and he took her by mental force.

Hypnotized, Kanami tapped into an inner sex maniac, a
personality dwelling deep inside her perverse fantasy core.
That "other" girl, brought to the surface, went mad
with lust and countless men. Then when it was over...

Glances from strangers...
Admonishments from teachers...
Her dearest friends...

Everything around her is changed, but how will she herself change from this? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE082258.html]DLsite English[/url]]
